question: Which of the following sets of articles is related with the feature of Emergency Provisions in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**352 to 360.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Emergency Provisions** in the Indian Constitution are related to the articles** 352 to 360.**
 
• These provisions allow the central government to take control of the state government in case of an emergency situation like **war, external aggression or armed rebellion.**
 
• Article 352 deals with the **proclamation of emergency,** while articles 353 to 355 outline the **effect of the emergency** on the powers of the central government, state government, and the fundamental rights of citizens.
 
• Article 356 empowers the President to dismiss a state government and** impose the President's rule **in case of failure of constitutional machinery in a state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Articles 309 to 312 **deal with the provisions related to the recruitment and conditions of service of persons serving the** Union or a State.**
 
• **Articles 343 to 351** deal with the provisions related to the **official language** of the Union and the States.
 
• **Articles 330 to 342 **deals with the provisions related to the representation of the **Anglo-Indian community **in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.
